From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, Sarah Li <sarah.li@acmedata.com>
Cc: Acme Finance Ops <financeops@acme.com>

Subject: Weekly forecast sprint: quick stage clean & 15m stakeholder huddle

Team / Sarah —

Quick reminder for this week’s forecast sprint. We want a focused hygiene pass (stage updates + commit flags) and a short 15-minute huddle to lock last-mile numbers before submission. Key asks: 

- Update all open opportunities in SF to the correct stage by EOD Tuesday (08/10). If the buyer is not engaged this week, move to "Stalled" and add one-line reason in the notes.
- Mark commit = YES only for deals with signed PO, verbal commit with buyer + finance alignment, or explicit next-step of "Close: 7 days".
- Use the attached forecast_template.xlsx for conservative/optimistic splits (column notes included).
- If a deal is in pilot/POC and you expect conversion this quarter, set stage to "Commit - Contingent" and add expected conversion date. Otherwise set to "Best Case".

Calendar: I scheduled a 15-minute huddle Tues 08/10 09:30-09:45 PT (calendar link below). Please add the account owner + your AM if you need them in the call. If you cannot make it, update the row in the shared Drive sheet before the huddle starts.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-forecast-templates (forecast_template.xlsx attached)

Attachments: forecast_template.xlsx

Why this matters: finance needs a final snapshot for the weekly submission; late churn on stages causes variance and extra reconciliation. We aim to keep post-submission adjustments <5% of commit.

Thanks — fast and focused here.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior RevOps Manager | Redwood Inference
prd: +1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Priyom — will do. Quick clarification: for the three POC deals in my lane (ACME-Integrate, ACME-ETL, ACME-SearchPilot), do you want them all to be "Commit - Contingent" given we have signed SOWs but no PO yet? Or leave one as "Best Case" since implementation start is after quarter end?

I can update them by EOD Tuesday once you confirm.

— Marissa
VP, Enterprise Accounts

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Cc: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acmedata.com>, Acme Finance Ops <financeops@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 08:58:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly forecast sprint: quick stage clean & 15m stakeholder huddle

Marissa — good question. Guideline:

- Commit - Contingent = Signed SOW + explicit buyer finance alignment AND a defined close trigger (e.g., PO submission or legal sign-off expected within quarter).
- Best Case = SOW signed but close trigger after quarter end, or any deal that still hinges on an unknown approval.

For your three: ACME-Integrate and ACME-ETL = Commit - Contingent (SOW signed and buyer expects PO this quarter). ACME-SearchPilot = Best Case (implementation start slated next quarter).

I attached a 1-pager agenda for the 15-minute huddle (CALL-AGENDA-15m.pdf). Please come with: 1) current stage, 2) commit flag, 3) any blocker and owner (one line). We’ll run 3-4 accounts per owner, rapid-fire.

If anyone needs exceptions (e.g., further validation calls before marking Commit), flag here and I’ll escalate to finance.

Attachments: CALL-AGENDA-15m.pdf
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=15m-huddle-20270808

— Priyom

From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acmedata.com>

See you Tuesday.

Best,
